faq.q: What is the maximum group size for boat rental in Marbella in 2043?
faq.a: The maximum group size is 12 passengers, as per Spanish maritime regulations. Larger yachts like the Ferretti 94 (29m) or Mangusta 80 (24m) can carry 12 pax. Smaller boats like the Dubhe (8m) are limited to 5 pax.

faq.q: Can I exceed the group size limit if I pay extra?
faq.a: No. Group size limits are set by law and safety regulations, not by price. Overloading a boat risks penalties and invalidates insurance. All charters must adhere to the certified passenger capacity.

faq.q: How many passengers can the Azimut 39 carry?
faq.a: The Azimut 39 (12.5m) carries up to 11 passengers. It departs from Puerto Banús and is part of Tier A pricing (€749/2h to €2,299/8h), including skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT.

faq.q: Are children counted in the group size limit?
faq.a: Yes, children of any age count as passengers. The total number of people on board, including infants, must not exceed the boat's certified capacity. Life jackets for children are provided.

faq.q: What are the group size limits for the Mangusta 80?
faq.a: The Mangusta 80 (24m) carries up to 12 passengers. It departs from Puerto Banús and is priced from €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter, which includes a free jet ski.

faq.q: Can I book a boat for a party of 15?
faq.a: No single boat in our fleet can carry 15 passengers. For larger groups, you would need to charter two boats simultaneously. Contact us via WhatsApp for custom multi-boat arrangements.

faq.q: Do the group size limits apply to the skipper?
faq.a: No. The skipper is not counted in the passenger capacity. The limits refer strictly to guests. Our licensed skipper is included with every charter and ensures safety compliance.

faq.q: What happens if my group exceeds the limit on the day?
faq.a: The charter will not depart until the group size matches the boat's certified capacity. Any extra guests will be asked to disembark. No refunds will be given for non-compliance.

data.body_html:
Planning a group outing on the Costa del Sol? Understanding the boat rental group size limits Marbella 2043 is essential for a smooth, safe, and legal charter. Each vessel in our fleet has a strict maximum passenger capacity, set by Spanish maritime law and the boat's safety certification. Whether you're celebrating a birthday, hosting a corporate event, or simply enjoying the Mediterranean with friends, knowing these limits helps you choose the right boat. Below, we break down the capacities for all our yachts, the reasoning behind the rules, and how to book without surprises.

Why Group Size Limits Exist

Group size limits are not arbitrary. They are based on the boat's design, stability, lifesaving equipment (life rafts, life jackets), and engine power. Spanish regulations (Real Decreto 876/2014) mandate that every recreational vessel has a certified maximum number of persons on board. Exceeding this limit voids insurance, risks capsizing, and can lead to fines of up to €6,000. Our charters always include a licensed skipper who enforces these limits.

Fleet Capacity Overview

Our fleet departs exclusively from Puerto Banús, Marbella. Here are the group size limits for each boat:

Matching Your Group to the Right Boat

For groups of 5 or fewer, the Dubhe (8m) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m) are economical options. For up to 8 guests, the Bandido (11.5m) offers a sporty experience. If you have 9-11 people, the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) or Azimut 39 (€749/2h) are excellent Tier A choices. For the full 12-person limit, choose any of the larger yachts like the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) or Ferretti 94 (pricing on request). All charters include a skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT.

What's Included in Every Charter

Every booking comes with: a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You don't need to worry about hidden costs. The group size limit is enforced from the moment you step aboard.

Booking Tips for Large Groups

If your party exceeds 12 people, you cannot fit everyone on one boat. However, you can charter two boats simultaneously—for example, a Mangusta 80 (12 pax) and an Azimut 39 (11 pax) for a total of 23 guests. Contact us via WhatsApp to coordinate itineraries and departure times. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, so you can meet at the marina and cruise together.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the maximum group size for boat rental in Marbella in 2043?

The maximum group size is 12 passengers, as per Spanish maritime regulations. Larger yachts like the Ferretti 94 (29m) or Mangusta 80 (24m) can carry 12 pax. Smaller boats like the Dubhe (8m) are limited to 5 pax.

Can I exceed the group size limit if I pay extra?

No. Group size limits are set by law and safety regulations, not by price. Overloading a boat risks penalties and invalidates insurance. All charters must adhere to the certified passenger capacity.

How many passengers can the Azimut 39 carry?

The Azimut 39 (12.5m) carries up to 11 passengers. It departs from Puerto Banús and is part of Tier A pricing (€749/2h to €2,299/8h), including skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT.

Are children counted in the group size limit?

Yes, children of any age count as passengers. The total number of people on board, including infants, must not exceed the boat's certified capacity. Life jackets for children are provided.

What are the group size limits for the Mangusta 80?

The Mangusta 80 (24m) carries up to 12 passengers. It departs from Puerto Banús and is priced from €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter, which includes a free jet ski.

Can I book a boat for a party of 15?

No single boat in our fleet can carry 15 passengers. For larger groups, you would need to charter two boats simultaneously. Contact us via WhatsApp for custom multi-boat arrangements.

Do the group size limits apply to the skipper?

No. The skipper is not counted in the passenger capacity. The limits refer strictly to guests. Our licensed skipper is included with every charter and ensures safety compliance.

What happens if my group exceeds the limit on the day?

The charter will not depart until the group size matches the boat's certified capacity. Any extra guests will be asked to disembark. No refunds will be given for non-compliance.

For more details on our fleet and bookings, visit our boat rental Marbella homepage or contact us directly. Understanding the boat rental group size limits Marbella 2043 ensures a hassle-free day on the water.
